hypothesis: Promoted memory delivered by the production agent run with source_db changes the task result, as judged by the protected tests.

conditions.control: box A: note written, NOT promoted
conditions.promoted: box B: same note promoted through the operator promotion API

pilots.rule: a pilot that passes the protected tests rejects the task; the series then cannot run

seed.drawn: at campaign start, from the OS entropy source

order: per task a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of 5 control + 5 promoted runs; task order also shuffled; pilots first

analysis.test: exact conditional stratified (convolution of hypergeometrics), two-sided, p = sum of probabilities <= observed
analysis.success: in EVERY task promoted >= 4/5 and control <= 1/5, AND p < 0.05

budget.ceiling_scope: cumulative over the whole campaign (all executions): prior_spend_usd + spend of this execution + worst-case projection of the next call never exceeds ceiling_usd
budget.prior_spend_note: execution 1 (2026-11-07) US$ 0.124, stopped on CONTROL_PROVIDER_BACKEND_DIVERGED; execution 2 (2026-11-08) US$ 1.3769 as measured by the script (console: 1.36). Counted in the cumulative ceiling gate
budget.ceiling_decision: Owner/Commander decision (2026-11-08): US$ 3.00 per complete campaign, cumulative. The earlier rule of stopping at 80% of US$ 3.00 is dropped for this execution because, on top of the spend already made, it would make the series impossible to complete; the hard stop at the full ceiling, projected before every call, replaces it
budget.price_rule: real mode needs --price-in and --price-out explicitly (finite, > 0) and equal to this registered price; otherwise it aborts before the first call. There is no built-in price for real mode
budget.price_note: operator-declared USD per million tokens; cached input charged at the input price; an estimate, not an invoice
budget.max_requests_note: the rehearsal needs at most 5 requests per run (write, check, answer plus context); 8 leaves 3 of slack. A run that needs more fails as cap-reached instead of spending without a bound
budget.per_request_check: before each call: prior_spend_usd + spent + worst-case projection (body bytes / 3 as tokens + max_tokens at the output price) > ceiling refuses the call
budget.unreadable_usage: the first request with unreadable usage ends the run as usage-unreadable and the campaign stops; the call is charged at the worst-case projection
budget.interrupted_request: a request cut by the 280 s timeout is charged with the declared context window as input plus max_tokens as output and is written to the request log

confirmation.rule: real mode runs only when the variable equals the hash printed by `f14v3.cjs --print-confirmation`; otherwise BLOCKED before any call
confirmation.covers: this plan, the prices, the protected cases and the content of the scripts listed in confirmation.cjs (GATED_FILES); not the rehearsal results

stop: failed series ends the campaign with no extra round; the cumulative ceiling is a hard stop (STOPPED: cumulative ceiling)
credential: read from an environment variable the operator provides at execution time; never from pass; never written or printed
